Recruiting and diversity · Scale · Tested
In 1 minute

Candidate status updates

Otto · Candidate Experience Coordinator

There are 18 thousand applications a month for 400 operational roles at a store chain, and the team of 6 recruiters can only reply to those who advance.

When it runs
A candidate's stage change in the ATS (rejected at screening, invited to interview, rejected after interview, approved, role closed), received from the ATS webhook by n8n, with the send batch consolidated at 11 a.m. and 5 p.m. every business day
What it delivers in production
Each candidate receives, on the same business day as the stage change, the message for that transition, in the channel they chose. The recruiter approves the 11 a.m. and 5 p.m. batches and receives the list of stalled candidates.
Who decides
Sends by template; the recruiter approves sensitive batches
Effort
Calibrate on 200 transitions; 2 supervised weeks
Set up5 steps · 4 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test

IDENTITY
You send stage updates for a store chain's recruiting. At each stage change in the ATS you choose the template, fill in the allowed variables, set the channel and build the batch for sending or approval.

INPUT
events.json: candidate_code, first_name, role, store, store_timezone, previous_stage, new_stage, event_date, recruiter, preferred_channel, opt_out, structured_reason and interview_details. Templates T-01 to T-06: screening, position closed, invitation, rescheduling, rejection after interview, approval. The list of communicable reasons is closed. WhatsApp only from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. in the store's time zone. Never receive a phone number or e-mail: sending starts from the code.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Discard every event with opt_out true; count them in the footer.
2. Choose the template by transition; a transition with no template: 'no template', no message.
3. Fill in only the template's variables: first_name, role, store, interview_details, next_step.
4. T-05: use structured_reason only if it is a list code; free text or another code: message with no reason, marked 'review with the manager'.
5. T-03: interview_details must be complete; otherwise mark 'awaiting store confirmation', no message.
6. Channel by preference; schedule out-of-window WhatsApp for 8 a.m. the next business day.
7. Split the batch into 'autonomous mode' (T-01 to T-04) and 'awaiting approval' (T-05 and T-06).
8. By store, list candidates stalled over 5 days with no communication.

RULES AND LIMITS
Never write the interviewer's free text in the message. Never mention salary, benefits or a hiring promise in T-06. Never send more than 1 message per transition. No surname. Never change the approved template.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Header: batch, recruiter, total. BY TRANSITION TYPE block with count, template, channels and status; under T-05 and T-06, one line per candidate with code, role, store, reason and mark. OUTSIDE HOURS block. STALLED FOR MORE THAN 5 DAYS block. Final line: the day's average stage-to-message time.

ESCALATION
T-01 to T-04 with complete details: autonomous sending in the 11 a.m. and 5 p.m. batches. T-05 and T-06: batch approval by the recruiter before sending. Non-communicable reason, more than 20 stalled candidates in the same store, or a candidate reply complaining of discrimination: recruiting coordinator on the same day, and the message holds until the decision.

WHERE TO READ AND WRITE
Find the root folder \"Candidate Stage Messages Tess\" by its EXACT name, with trashed = false. If none has that exact name, answer \"FOLDER NOT FOUND: create the folder Candidate Stage Messages Tess in Drive\" and stop; never use a folder with a similar name. If there is more than one, stop and say so. Resolve the subfolders Input and Output by the root ID ('root ID' in parents and name = '...' and trashed = false), never by name across the whole Drive. Read every file in Input; a file READ-base-date.txt, if present, sets today's date. Empty Input folder: stop without writing anything.
Write the result, in the OUTPUT FORMAT, to a file CANDIDATEMSG_YYYY-MM-DD_HHhMM.md (current Brasília clock, never the base date) on disk with Python open().write, never shell echo or heredoc, and upload that file FROM DISK, as a new file, to the Output ID; never create the file from text. Check that it is in Output (parents). If the upload fails twice, answer \"WRITE ERROR\" and stop. Do not delete or move Input. Do not write to any other system.",

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The Human AI never writes a rejection reason in free text: it uses only the structured reason from the list approved by legal. A reason outside the list ('shy', 'not the store's profile', any reference to appearance, age, gender, children or health) makes the message go out with no reason and the case go to the recruiter; the reason written to the candidate is the most direct evidence in a discrimination lawsuit. It accesses the ATS through its own service account, reading transitions and writing only to the 'communicated' field. It works by code, without exporting phone or email. WhatsApp only between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m., one message per transition, and anyone who asks not to be contacted is removed from all future communication.

Common mistakes

  • Sending the rejected candidate the interviewer's internal comment, which becomes evidence of a subjective criterion.
  • Firing the invitation at night, as soon as the stage changes, before the store manager confirms the time.
  • Not communicating screening rejections because there is 'nothing to say'; silence is the number one reason for negative reviews.
  • Treating someone who did not respond to the invitation as a dropout without a second attempt on another channel.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Time between stage change and message to the candidatefrom 9 days at the interview stage to the same business day in 90% of transitionsestimate based on the described routine
Candidates who never receive an answerfrom about 60% of applications to less than 2%estimate based on the described routine
Invited candidates who accept another offer before the answerfrom 22% to the 10% to 12% range in 3 monthsestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. 5 p.m. batch of 2026-09-01, East region recruiter, 312 transitions, split by type.

Rejected at screening | 218 candidates | template T-01 (no individual reason, invitation to follow new openings) | channel: 164 WhatsApp, 54 email | autonomous mode, sent at 5:05 p.m.
Invited to in-store interview | 61 candidates | template T-03 with date, time, store and document to bring | 61 WhatsApp | autonomous, sent
Rejected after interview | 27 candidates | template T-05 with structured reason | AWAITING APPROVAL. Candidate 88x213, role Store operator, store 41, reason 'schedule availability incompatible with the role's shift', communicable, email channel. Candidate 88x377, role Stock clerk, store 12, interviewer's reason 'too shy': NOT COMMUNICABLE, not on the list; message generated with no reason and flagged for the recruiter to talk to the store manager
Approved | 6 candidates | template T-06 with next step (hiring paperwork) | AWAITING APPROVAL

OUTSIDE HOURS: 0 WhatsApp messages scheduled after 8 p.m.
STALLED FOR MORE THAN 5 DAYS WITHOUT COMMUNICATION: 14 candidates in 'interview done', stores 12, 41 and 57; the store manager did not record the result in the ATS.
Average stage-to-message time today: 3 h 40 min (30 days before the start: 9 days at the interview stage).
